violations.description: Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --Cloth for wiping food spills was not stored in sanitizing solution between uses.--In-use utensil \Ice scoop was not properly stored during pauses in food preparation or dispensing. Store ice scoop in a container that can be easily cleaned, remove towel from the top of ice maker.
Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Clean fans for air circulation in kitchen area.
Storage and handling of maintenance items. — --Wet-use maintenance items, such as mops, were not placed in a position that allows proper air-drying. Hang mops up after use to allow for drying.
Ventilation hood systems - Design and construction. — --Ventilation hood system was not designed and/or maintained properly. -Repair gap in filters on hood.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Equipment that dispenses liquid/food/ice in unpackaged form was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required. -Ice machine needs cleaned inside.
General premises. — --Perimeter walls and roof did not effectively protect establishment from the weather and entry of insects, rodents, and other animals. -Back door has gap at bottom.
